inputThis:
$:printf 'AUTH VAR PRESENCE
'; for x in GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN WORKSPACE_API_TOKEN GITHUB_API_TOKEN; do if [ -n "${!x:-}" ]; then printf '%s=SET
' "$x"; else printf '%s=UNSET
' "$x"; fi; done; printf '
GH AUTH
'; gh auth status 2>&1 | sed -E 's/(Token: ).*/\1[redacted]/'; printf '
REMOTE
'; git remote -v | sed -E 's#https://[^@ ]+@github.com#https://[redacted]@github.com#g'; printf '
TASK STATE
'; find Tasks -type f | sort; printf '
WORKFLOW PERMISSION CONFIG
'; grep -n -E 'permissions:|GH_TOKEN:|GITHUB_TOKEN:|WORKSPACE_API' .github/workflows/*issue* .github/workflows/*terminal* 2>/dev/null | head -60
outputThat: ✓ Logged in to github.com account github-actions[bot] (GH_TOKEN)
